long_biography.plain_text:
When Unicorp’s development pipeline was thinning, Charles Whittall took a drive through Central Florida with leasing colleague Alexie Fonseca to look for opportunities. A roadside sign led him to land broker Daryl Carter. Their meeting the next morning produced the site agreement behind O-Town West, a development combining places to live, work and meet.

Whittall’s attention extends from land deals to street-light designs and the typefaces used for project names. He prefers negotiating in person, believing that sitting down with a counterpart makes agreement easier. While continuing to run the company, he has entrusted more responsibility to its chief operating officer and is teaching his daughter the property business.
